role: RED TEAM PATIENT PORTAL & ONLINE BOOKING DUPLICATES & ORPHANS INQUISITOR

findings.description: Insecure static OTP bypass codes ('0000', '1234', '000000', '123456') in publicBookingQueueService.ts permitted unauthorized phone verification in production without environment gate.
findings.resolution: Locked behind namedDevelopmentModeActive() and explicit NODE_ENV test/development check; strictly rejected in production. Added test 12.

findings.description: Hardcoded fallback expectedCode '748291' in PatientCabinetModal.tsx allowed bypassing SMS OTP if sentOtp was not generated.
findings.resolution: Removed fallback; sentOtp is strictly required.

findings.description: Patient portal had no backend endpoint to cancel appointments (PATCH /appointments/:id/cancel) or fetch bookable clinic doctors (GET /doctors).
findings.resolution: Implemented PATCH /api/portal/appointments/:id/cancel with tenant isolation and status guards; implemented GET /api/portal/doctors.

findings.description: GET /api/portal/me only returned visits, ignoring scheduled appointments table, patient relationships, and family group balance.
findings.resolution: Expanded GET /api/portal/me to return enriched appointments from schedule, familyGroups balance, and familyMembers from patientRelationships.

findings.description: PatientCabinetModal only updated local React state upon booking or cancellation without calling backend APIs.
findings.resolution: Wired handleBookingSubmit to POST /api/portal/appointments and handleCancelAppointment to PATCH /api/portal/appointments/:id/cancel.
